featured_reviews.name: Rohini Gaikwad_Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am very happy and satisfied with Orchid School, Dombivli, where both my daughters are currently studying. The school provides a perfect balance between academics and overall personality development.

The teaching staff is highly supportive, well-qualified, and always approachable. They focus on concept clarity rather than rote learning, which has really helped my children build confidence in their studies. I have seen a significant improvement in their communication skills and overall growth.

The school also gives equal importance to extracurricular activities like sports, arts, and cultural programs, which helps in the holistic development of children. The environment is safe, positive, and encouraging.

What I appreciate the most is the regular communication between teachers and parents, ensuring that we are always updated about our children’s progress.

featured_reviews.name: Trupti Kashid
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a parent, I feel that Orchid International School in Dombivli follows a modern approach to education with a well-structured curriculum. The school focuses not only on academics but also on overall personality development, which is a big plus. Activities like public speaking, extracurricular programs, and concept-based learning help children gain confidence and practical knowledge.
The school also includes structured training in music, dance, and drama as part of its curriculum, helping students develop their creative skills

The infrastructure is good, with well-maintained classrooms and facilities. Also, depending on the class and teacher, the experience can vary, so consistency is something that can improve.

However, like many private schools, the fee structure is on the higher side, which may not be suitable for everyone.

Overall, it’s a good option for parents looking for a school that emphasizes holistic development along with academics.

featured_reviews.name: Priya Vaishnav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to share feedback regarding my daughter’s progress this academic year. I truly appreciate the consistent effort, support, and guidance provided by you and the school.

Over the past years, I have observed significant improvement in her academic understanding, discipline, and overall confidence. The teaching methods used in the classroom, along with the regular communication from the school, have helped her develop a stronger interest in learning.

I am especially happy to see improvement in the following areas:

Her classroom participation and willingness to ask questions

Better understanding of concepts taught in class

I also appreciate the school’s focus on extracurricular activities, which helps in her holistic development. The friendly, encouraging, and structured environment created by teachers has made a noticeable impact on her learning journey.

Overall, I am extremely satisfied with the efforts of the school and thankful for the dedication shown by the teachers. Thank you for your continuous support and for helping my daughter grow academically and personally.

featured_reviews.name: Prathamesh Bobhate

Communication with parents is transparent, and many kids genuinely enjoy going to school every day. Excellent choice if you’re looking for quality education with a positive environment.
